end.summary: Discussed why some objects float and others sink.
end.parentNote: Yash practised predicting whether objects such as stones, coins, wood, leaves, plastic lids and spoons would float or sink. They used a class observation about a wooden piece floating and a coin sinking. The mix-up that a stone floats because it is light was corrected later: Yash stated that stones sink, though the material-based explanation still needs practice. At home, sort a few safe household objects by whether they float or sink, then discuss what each is made of.
